Completed all three sidebar changes on issue #5 'fwgt16-n2 Bench Issue' (http://127.0.0.1:8095/bench/bench-repo/issues/5). The previous attempt had failed because the Fomantic dropdown items only commit when the dropdown is closed — the working pattern was: open the combobox, click the option in the listbox (which ticks it in the open menu), then press Escape to close the dropdown, which triggers the save. Applied: (1) Labels — clicked 'bug' then 'priority-high' in the Labels picker; (2) Assignees — clicked 'bench-assignee (Bench Assignee)'; (3) Milestone — clicked 'Bench Milestone'. After each picker the sidebar text was read back confirming the applied state, and finally the page was fully reloaded (goto) and all three values re-read from the fresh page, confirming they persisted server-side: Labels shows chips 'bug' and 'priority-high' (exactly those two, no others), Assignees shows 'bench-assignee' with full name '(Bench Assignee)' and avatar, Milestone shows 'Bench Milestone'. A screenshot was captured as evidence.
